meta.name: depmap
meta.description: Query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles. Use for identifying cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validating oncology drug targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询癌症依赖图谱数据，发现肿瘤靶点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在癌症研究中使用DepMap数据筛选基因依赖或药物敏感性。
copy.tagline_en: Query cancer dependency map data to discover tumor targets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze cancer gene dependencies or drug sensitivity data from DepMap.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能查询癌症细胞系的 CRISPR Chronos 基因依赖分数、药物敏感性和基因效应谱;还能找出特定癌症类型中依赖某基因的细胞系,检验变异是否预测依赖,以及给出共必需或合成致死候选基因。
howto.when: 当你的问题涉及癌症细胞系的基因依赖和必需性、药物敏感性的预测标志物,或合成致死配对时触发。

say.text: 查一下 KRAS 在肺癌细胞系里的 Chronos 依赖分数。
say.note: 会返回各癌系得分并筛出依赖较强的细胞系。

say.text: 找 BRCA1 突变细胞系中比野生型更依赖的基因,做合成致死筛选。
say.note: 会比较突变组与野生型的基因效应。

say.text: 列出和 MYC 共必需性最高的 20 个基因。
say.note: 会按依赖谱相关性输出排名靠前的基因。

howto.what_en: Claude can query DepMap for CRISPR Chronos dependency scores, drug sensitivity and gene effect data. It finds cell lines dependent on a gene, checks mutation biomarkers, and lists co-essential / synthetic lethal candidates.
howto.when_en: Used when you ask about the essentiality of a gene in cancer cell lines, predictive biomarkers for drug sensitivity, or synthetic lethal partners.

say_en.text: Check Chronos dependency scores for KRAS in lung cancer cell lines.
say_en.note: Returns per-line scores and the most dependent lines.

say_en.text: Find genes more essential in BRCA1-mutant lines than wild-type lines.
List the top 20 genes co-essential with MYC.
say_en.note: Ranks genes by correlation with MYC dependency.
